home.tagline: Jagora mai tausayi kan ciki, murmurewa bayan haihuwa da sauran matakai.
home.prototype: SAMFURIN BINCIKE DA ƘIRƘIRA · ABUJA, NAJERIYA
language.help: Zaɓi harshen da kake so. Har yanzu ana duba fassarar wasu bayanan lafiyar uwa.
language.notice: Ana ci gaba da fassara: wasu bayanan lafiyar uwa suna nan da Turanci har sai an duba fassararsu. Kada a dogara da fassarar da ba a tantance ba wajen yanke shawarar lafiya.
home.lead: Tallafi daga lokacin ciki zuwa bayan haihuwa da kulawar jariri.
home.about_body: HerMamaAI na nuna ilimin ciki, jin daɗin uwa bayan haihuwa, lafiyar tunani, neman wuraren kulawa da tsara rigakafin yara. Har yanzu ana gwada shi; ba a tabbatar da ingancinsa ta gwajin asibiti ba.
home.continues: Kulawa tana ci gaba bayan haihuwa.
safety.heading: Muhimman bayanan tsaro
safety.caption: Don ilimi kawai · Ba madadin kulawar ƙwararrun lafiya ba.
ac.goal: Zaɓi burin jin daɗi guda ɗaya
ac.energy: Nawa ne ƙarfinka don ƙaramin mataki yau?
ac.restart: Na rasa wani buri ko ina buƙatar sake farawa cikin sauƙi
ac.steps: Ƙananan matakan da za ka iya ɗauka
ac.why: Me ya sa aka nuna waɗannan shawarwari?
ac.completed: Na kammala aƙalla mataki ɗaya yau
ac.completed_count: Bayanan da aka ce an kammala
home.continues_body: Koyi lokacin tuntuɓar ƙungiyar kula da haihuwa da yadda za ka shirya kulawar gaba.
ui.Support around you: Tallafin da ke kusa da ke
ui.I need urgent medical help: Ina buƙatar taimakon gaggawa na lafiya
ui.Your optional small steps: Ƙananan matakan da za ki iya ɗauka
ui.Why were these suggestions shown?: Me ya sa aka nuna waɗannan shawarwari?
ui.No appointments entered yet. Add a vi: Ba a ƙara alƙawari ba tukuna. Ƙara ziyara a sama.
ui.Questions for your maternity team: Tambayoyi ga masu kula da haihuwarki
notice: Ana ci gaba da fassara: wasu bayanan lafiyar uwa suna nan da Turanci har sai an duba fassararsu. Kada a dogara da fassarar da ba a tantance ba wajen yanke shawarar lafiya.
ui.Add a demo parent and baby: Ƙara iyaye da jariri na gwaji
ui.What might my baby need at this age?: Me jaririna zai iya buƙata a wannan shekarun?
ui.Choose a routine visit age: Zaɓi shekarun ziyarar yau da kullum
ui.Indicative visit milestones and vacci: Matakan ziyara da rigakafin da za a tattauna
ui.Planned clinic visit date (future dat: Ranar ziyarar asibiti da aka tsara
ui.Record a vaccine already received: Rubuta rigakafin da aka riga aka yi
ui.Dose number as shown on card (optiona: Lambar kashi kamar a katin (na zaɓi)
ui.Clear all temporary immunization entr: Share duk bayanan rigakafi na wucin gadi
ui.Questions to ask a facility before a: Tambayoyin da za a yi wa asibiti kafin ziyara
preg.intro: Ziyarar kula da ciki akai-akai na taimaka wa ma'aikatan lafiya su duba lafiyarki da ci gaban jariri. Tambayi ƙwararrun lafiya irin ziyarori, gwaje-gwaje da rigakafin da suka dace da ke.
post.intro: Murmurewa na ci gaba bayan an sallame ki daga asibiti. Matsaloli masu tsanani na iya faruwa ko bayan haihuwa mai sauƙi. Ki halarci ziyarorin bayan haihuwa da aka ba ki.
well.intro: Ciki da zama uwa na iya kawo ji iri-iri. Kin cancanci tallafi da damar bayyana yadda kike ji.
calm.intro: Wurin hutawa ga iyaye mata da masu shirin zama uwa. Yi wasa a hankali ko ki huta. Babu maki, gasa ko buƙatar bayanan sirri.
learn.intro: Nau'ikan batutuwa da za ki tattauna da ƙwararrun masu kula da haihuwa.
baby.intro: Wannan gwajin shirin rigakafi ne don ilimi kawai, ba katin asibiti ko jadawalin rigakafi na hukuma ba. Tabbatar da rigakafi da lokacinsa tare da ƙwararren ma'aikacin lafiya.
find.intro: Duba jerin asibitocin koyarwa da gwamnati ta lissafo a Abuja da sauran biranen Najeriya. Wannan taimakon shiri ne, ba tura marar lafiya ko yin alƙawari ba.
mama.intro: Kulawa ba ta ƙare da haihuwa ba. Karanta bayanan tallafi bayan haihuwa, ki shirya ziyarar gaba da ma'aikatan lafiyarki.
ac.intro: Nuna gwajin tallafin ɗabi'un jin daɗin uwa bisa ƙa'idoji • Don ilimi kawai
ui.Tap **Plant a flower** to create a li: Danna **Shuka fure** don yin ƙaramin lambu. Babu ƙidayar lokaci ko kuskure.
ui.You deserve support, rest and care. T: Kin cancanci tallafi, hutu da kulawa. Ɗan hutu ya isa a yanzu.
ui.Confirm my next postpartum appointmen: Tabbatar da alƙawarin ziyara ta gaba bayan haihuwa
ui.Write down questions about pain, blee: Rubuta tambayoyi kan ciwo, zubar jini ko warkewa
ui.Ask about emotional well-being and sl: Tambayi game da jin daɗin zuciya da barci
ui.Discuss feeding and contraception if: Tattauna shayarwa da tsarin iyali idan ya dace
ui.Arrange transport or someone to accom: Shirya abin hawa ko wanda zai raka ni idan ana buƙata
ui.Choose what you need today. These are: Zaɓi abin da kike buƙata yau. Waɗannan kayan ilimi ne, ba sa sa ido na asibiti.
ui.These stages are educational, not a p: Waɗannan matakai na ilimi ne, ba jadawalin kulawa da aka rubuta ba. Murmurewar kowace uwa ta bambanta.
ui.Use your maternity team's own follow-: Bi umarnin ƙungiyar kula da haihuwarki da jadawalin alƙawari.
ui.Checklists are session-only. This mod: Jerin dubawa na wannan zaman kawai ne. Wannan sashen ba ya yin alƙawari ko aika tunatarwa.
